concept: IAM: EC2 role via instance profile instead of access keys
tests: The recommended way to give an application on EC2 access to S3.
expected: Attach an IAM role (instance profile) with a least-privilege s3:GetObject policy on the bucket — temporary, automatically rotated credentials. Triggers: "EC2 application", "no credentials", "recommended way".
why_not: Access keys in env vars — leak risk and manual rotation; a bucket policy by public IP — the wrong mechanism; ACLs — legacy and can't reference an instance.
